addons.name: World Monitor
addons.summary: A live globe of world events on the Situation screen and the tablet.
addons.details: World Monitor (github.com/koala73/worldmonitor, by Elie Habib, AGPL-3.0, free for personal use) runs beside IRIS in Docker and stays on this computer. Setup downloads and builds it, which takes 10 to 20 minutes the first time.
permissions: Downloads World Monitor from its own GitHub repository
Runs it in Docker on this computer only
Starts Docker Desktop when IRIS starts
